shortBio: Eddy Lukovic is a New York–based actor and director working across film, television, and theatre — drawn to characters who carry more than they say.
paragraphs: Eddy Lukovic is an actor based in New York City. Raised between two languages and two cultures, he came to acting through a love of stories about people caught between worlds — immigrants, outsiders, quiet men with loud interior lives.

He trained in the Meisner technique and has worked across independent film, episodic television, and downtown theatre. Recent acting work includes the short film 'Northbound', a recurring role on a network procedural, and a new play developed at a New York theatre lab.

As a director he gravitates to small rooms and big stakes — chamber plays and short films where the camera or the audience sits close. Recent directing work includes 'The Pillowman' at Basement Theatre Lab and the short film 'Static', which he also wrote.
When he isn't on set or in rehearsal, Eddy writes, boxes badly, and makes a very serious pot of coffee. He believes the best acting disappears — you don't watch it, you recognize it.
